scenes.say: When a system slows down or stops, what’s your first step? Let’s talk about the method that interviewers want to see every time.

rows.b: Pinpoint what fails and error text

scenes.say: Start by defining what’s broken. Scope out who’s hit and where. Reproduce the issue yourself. Walk through each layer, and split the path to test from the middle.
Always compare a working setup to the broken one. Look at logs, client behavior, and latency. This narrows down what changed.

scenes.question: What impresses interview panels most?
scenes.wrong: A quick fix or lucky guess
scenes.right: A calm, structured troubleshooting method is what they grade highest. It beats luck every time.
scenes.say: Interviewers care more about your method than a lucky fix. Don’t skip steps—show your calm, structured approach.
